records.subject: Need to uphold brotherhood, unity and social harmony in the Society.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Chowdry Mohammad Ramzan: I draw attention of the Government to the need of preserving brotherhood, unity and social harmony in our country. India?s strength lies in its diversity and the constitutional values of equality, fraternity and justice. Any expression of hatred or discrimination against any section, caste or community weakens our social fabric and must be firmly discouraged.? I would also like to express concern over reports of harassment faced by Kashmiri students, labourers and traders in different parts of the country, which creates fear and insecurity among innocent citizens. Such incidents are disturbing and go against the spirit of national unity. I urge the Government to take appropriate steps to ensure their safety, promote harmony, and strengthen mutual respect and inclusiveness, so that every citizen feels secure and equally valued in our great nation.

(ENDS)
